PlagueBurstPlayer.description: Triggered when an enemy Poisoned by a supported skill dies, dealing Physical damage around them based on the built-up Plague.
PlagueBurstPlayer.name: Plague Burst

SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.
SupportAddedLightningDamagePlayer.name: Lightning Attunement

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayer.name: Adhesive Grenades I

SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.
SupportAdhesiveGrenadesPlayerTwo.name: Adhesive Grenades II

SupportAdmixturePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.
SupportAdmixturePlayer.name: Admixture

SupportAilithLineagePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can expend Combo. On expending Combo with Supported Skills, you have a chance to gain Power Charges based on the amount of Combo expended.
flavourText: Ailith awoke to find her fire iridescent, and her mind alive
with visions. By morning, she began teaching what she'd
seen... thus was born the Keepers of the Pale Vision.
SupportAilithLineagePlayer.name: Ailith's Chimes

SupportAlignmentPlayer.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayer.name: Alignment I

SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayerThree.name: Alignment III

SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.
SupportAlignmentPlayerTwo.name: Alignment II

SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayer.name: Ammo Conservation I

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.description: Supports Crossbow Skills, causing them to load a bolt into all Crossbow Ammunition on kill.
flavourText: Confident their enemy was defenseless, the Keitans brazenly
charged the walls - but Arjun's ammunition supply reports
had been... 'inaccurate'... just like everything else Bardiyan.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerFour.name: Arjun's Medal

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing, at the cost of Reload speed.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerThree.name: Ammo Conservation III

SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, granting a chance to not consume a Bolt when firing.
SupportAmmoConservationPlayerTwo.name: Ammo Conservation II

SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.
flavourText: She flashed a smile full of wicked teeth. "Sin, my darling.
Forget your Maraketh woes." She bit and tore and reveled;
he lay trapped in silk, wrought with despair and ecstasy.
SupportArakaalisLustPlayer.name: Arakaali's Lust

SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.description: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.
flavourText: "Those who bored the Queen suffered an excessive punishment:
everyone they had ever known would be killed, effectively
erasing their life. So, no matter the cost... none kept her waiting."
SupportAtzirisImpatiencePlayer.name: Atziri's Impatience

SupportBlindPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.
SupportBlindPlayer.name: Blind I

SupportBlindPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.
SupportBlindPlayerTwo.name: Blind II

SupportBlindsidePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.
SupportBlindsidePlayer.name: Blindside

SupportBountyPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.
SupportBountyPlayer.name: Bounty I

SupportBountyPlayerTwo.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Flask and Charm charges.
SupportBountyPlayerTwo.name: Bounty II

SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.description: Supports skills that can Poison enemies, causing Poisoned enemies to gain Plague over time and explode in a Plague Burst on death. Cannot support the skills of Minions.
SupportBurstingPlaguePlayer.name: Bursting Plague

SupportCadencePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.
SupportCadencePlayer.name: Cadence

SupportCaltropsPlayer.description: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.
SupportCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops

SupportChainPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayer.name: Chain I

SupportChainPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayerThree.name: Chain III

SupportChainPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.
SupportChainPlayerTwo.name: Chain II

SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.description: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.
SupportChargeInhibitionPlayer.name: Inhibitor

SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so.
SupportChargeProfusionPlayer.name: Charge Profusion I

SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills that can generate Charges, giving them a chance to generate an additional Charge when they do so, as well as a chance to generate an additional Charge of a random type.
SupportChargeProfusionPlayerTwo.name: Charge Profusion II

SupportChargedMarkPlayer.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.
SupportChargedMarkPlayer.name: Charged Mark

SupportChargedShotsPlayer.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
SupportChargedShotsPlayer.name: Charged Shots I

SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.
SupportChargedShotsPlayerTwo.name: Charged Shots II

SupportCharmBountyPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.
SupportCharmBountyPlayer.name: Charm Bounty

SupportCloseCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
SupportCloseCombatPlayer.name: Close Combat I

SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.
SupportCloseCombatPlayerTwo.name: Close Combat II

SupportCombatReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to load multiple extra bolts and attack faster. Supported Skills cannot reload normally, instead loading bolts when you Dodge.
flavourText: "No plan. No stealth. I want shock. Awe. I want them to
know who did it, and I want them telling tales. That's the
only way for us to earn their respect... and their fear."
SupportCombatReloadPlayer.name: Ratha's Assault

SupportComboFinisherPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
SupportComboFinisherPlayer.name: Combo Finisher I

SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until enough Combo has been built up, but deal massively more damage. Cannot support skills which already Combo.
SupportComboFinisherPlayerTwo.name: Combo Finisher II

SupportCommiseratePlayer.description: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.
SupportCommiseratePlayer.name: Commiserate

SupportControlledHazardPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.
SupportControlledHazardPlayer.name: Controlled Hazard

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayer.name: Cooldown Recovery I

SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover. Cannot modify the skills of minions.
SupportCooldownRecoveryPlayerTwo.name: Cooldown Recovery II

SupportCorrosionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.
SupportCorrosionPlayer.name: Corrosion

SupportCullingStrikePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit.
SupportCullingStrikePlayer.name: Culling Strike I

SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to Cull Rare and Unique Enemies on Hit, and increasing the threshold at which they will Cull Enemies.
SupportCullingStrikePlayerTwo.name: Culling Strike II

SupportCulminationPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportCulminationPlayer.name: Culmination I

SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportCulminationPlayerTwo.name: Culmination II

SupportDazePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to build up Daze based on a portion of Physical Damage dealt.
SupportDazePlayer.name: Daze

SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.description: Supports Herald Skills, making their triggered effects deal more damage at the expense of higher Spirit cost.
SupportDeadlyHeraldsPlayer.name: Deadly Herald

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayer.name: Deadly Poison I

SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal less damage but inflict more potent Poison.
SupportDeadlyPoisonPlayerTwo.name: Deadly Poison II

SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.description: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.
SupportDelayedGratificationPlayer.name: Delayed Gratification

SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.
SupportDelayedReactionPlayer.name: Delayed Reaction

SupportDeliberationPlayer.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.
SupportDeliberationPlayer.name: Deliberation

SupportDurabilityPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportDurabilityPlayer.name: Durability

SupportElectrocutePlayer.description: Supports any Skill which can deal Damage. Lightning Damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock.
SupportElectrocutePlayer.name: Electrocute

SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.description: Supports skills that can Empower skills other than themselves, causing skills they Empower to Cull enemies.
SupportEmpoweredCullPlayer.name: Murderous Intent

SupportEonyrsThunderPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which can deal damage. Lightning damage from Supported Skills can inflict Electrocute, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Shock. Enemies slain while Electrocuted by Supported Skills explode, dealing a percentage of their maximum Life as Lightning damage.
flavourText: "How? Well, the Great Wyvern granted her passage, of course.
Eonyr and his flock soar the winds between us and the Moon.
The roar of the storm... that's them, as they hunt and call."
SupportEonyrsThunderPlayer.name: Eonyr's Thunder

SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing it to inflict an extra Poison on enemies but shortening the duration of those Poisons.
SupportEscalatingPoisonPlayer.name: Escalating Poison

SupportFarCombatPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
SupportFarCombatPlayer.name: Longshot I

SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage from farther away.
SupportFarCombatPlayerTwo.name: Longshot II

SupportFerocityPlayer.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.
SupportFerocityPlayer.name: Ferocity

SupportForkPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.
SupportForkPlayer.name: Fork

SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.
SupportFrenziedRipostePlayer.name: Frenzied Riposte

SupportFrozenSpitePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
SupportFrozenSpitePlayer.name: Frozen Spite

SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.
flavourText: At the last, her hope gone - but not her resolve - she threw her
beloved Tangletongue. That was the day a god bled. For this, the
Great Roc graced a Maraketh warrior with a feather for the first time.
SupportGarukhansResolvePlayer.name: Garukhan's Resolve

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayer.name: Heightened Accuracy I

SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.
SupportHeightenedAccuracyPlayerTwo.name: Heightened Accuracy II

SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.description: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.
SupportHeightenedChargesPlayer.name: Heightened Charges

SupportHitAndRunPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.
SupportHitAndRunPlayer.name: Hit and Run

SupportImpalePlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.
SupportImpalePlayer.name: Impale

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayer.name: Overabundance I

SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a Limit, increasing that Limit at the cost of their duration. Only applies to restrictions that use the word "Limit".
SupportIncreaseLimitPlayerTwo.name: Overabundance II

SupportInnervatePlayer.description: Supports damaging skills you use yourself. Killing a Shocked enemy with supported skills imbues your damage with Lightning damage for a short time.
SupportInnervatePlayer.name: Innervate

SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.description: Supports any skill that you can use, triggering a blast of wind that Knocks Back enemies if you are Stunned while using it.
SupportKnockbackWavePlayer.name: Wind Wave

SupportLastingShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.
SupportLastingShockPlayer.name: Lasting Shock

SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Life Flask charges.
SupportLifeFlaskPlayer.name: Life Bounty

SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Life when it Culls an enemy.
SupportLifeOnCullPlayer.name: Life Drain

SupportLightningExposurePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Exposure when inflicting Shock.
SupportLightningExposurePlayer.name: Lightning Exposure

SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.
SupportLightningPenetrationPlayer.name: Lightning Penetration

SupportLockdownPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing any Pin buildup it inflicts to be stronger the closer the enemy is to you.
SupportLockdownPlayer.name: Lockdown

SupportMaimPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.
SupportMaimPlayer.name: Maim

SupportMaladyPlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.
SupportMaladyPlayer.name: Malady

SupportManaFlaskPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing enemies it kills to grant more Mana Flask charges.
SupportManaFlaskPlayer.name: Mana Bounty

SupportManaOnCullPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Mana when it Culls an enemy.
SupportManaOnCullPlayer.name: Soul Drain

SupportMobilityPlayer.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, allowing you to move faster while using them.
SupportMobilityPlayer.name: Mobility

SupportMomentumPlayer.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.
SupportMomentumPlayer.name: Momentum

SupportMultishotPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
SupportMultishotPlayer.name: Multishot I

SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.
SupportMultishotPlayerTwo.name: Multishot II

SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.
SupportNeuralOverloadPlayer.name: Neural Overload

SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills, causing them to Reload bolts significantly faster.
SupportNimbleReloadPlayer.name: Nimble Reload

SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.
SupportNovaProjectilesPlayer.name: Nova Projectiles I

SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.
SupportNovaProjectilesTwoPlayer.name: Nova Projectiles II

SupportOverchargePlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.
SupportOverchargePlayer.name: Overcharge

SupportOverextendPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.
SupportOverextendPlayer.name: Overextend

SupportOverreachPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.
SupportOverreachPlayer.name: Overreach

SupportPayloadPlayer.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.
SupportPayloadPlayer.name: Payload

SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.
SupportPerfectEndurancePlayer.name: Perfected Endurance

SupportPerfectionPlayer.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.
SupportPerfectionPlayer.name: Perfection

SupportPiercePlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.
SupportPiercePlayer.name: Pierce I

SupportPiercePlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.
SupportPiercePlayerThree.name: Pierce III

SupportPiercePlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.
SupportPiercePlayerTwo.name: Pierce II

SupportPietysMercyPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.
flavourText: The High Templar needed thousands of prisoners if his and
Piety's experiments were to succeed. Conspiring on the
matter, they decided to revive an age old tradition... exile.
SupportPietysMercyPlayer.name: Dominus' Grasp

SupportPinPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun.
SupportPinPlayer.name: Pin I

SupportPinPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun. Pin buildup caused by Supported Skill is lessened, but Pin duration is significantly longer.
SupportPinPlayerThree.name: Pin III

SupportPinPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, allowing its Physical damage to Pin enemies but making it unable to Stun, as well as granting Critial Hit Chance against Immobilised enemies.
SupportPinPlayerTwo.name: Pin II

SupportPoisonPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayer.name: Poison I

SupportPoisonPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayerThree.name: Poison III

SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.
SupportPoisonPlayerTwo.name: Poison II

SupportPoisonSpores.description: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.
SupportPoisonSpores.name: Poison Spores

SupportPracticedComboPlayer.description: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.
SupportPracticedComboPlayer.name: Practiced Combo

SupportPrecisionPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.
SupportPrecisionPlayer.name: Precision I

SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to gain increased Accuracy while the Skill is active.
SupportPrecisionPlayerTwo.name: Precision II

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayer.name: Projectile Acceleration I

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerThree.name: Projectile Acceleration III

SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.
SupportProjectileAccelerationPlayerTwo.name: Projectile Acceleration II

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayer.name: Projectile Deceleration I

SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.
SupportProjectileDecelerationPlayerTwo.name: Projectile Deceleration II

SupportPunchThroughPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.
SupportPunchThroughPlayer.name: Punch Through

SupportPursuitPlayer.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayer.name: Pursuit I

SupportPursuitPlayerThree.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayerThree.name: Pursuit III

SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.
SupportPursuitPlayerTwo.name: Pursuit II

SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.
flavourText: The Tasalio Tribe developed their own Way, seeing
the world not as it is, but as it should be, given its
roiling and endless grace of constant motion.
SupportRakiatasFlowPlayer.name: Rakiata's Flow

SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayer.name: Rapid Attacks I

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerThree.name: Rapid Attacks III

SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.
SupportRapidAttacksPlayerTwo.name: Rapid Attacks II

SupportRearmPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
SupportRearmPlayer.name: Rearm I

SupportRearmPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.
SupportRearmPlayerTwo.name: Rearm II

SupportRetreatPlayer.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayer.name: Retreat I

SupportRetreatPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayerThree.name: Retreat III

SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.
SupportRetreatPlayerTwo.name: Retreat II

SupportRicochetPlayer.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
SupportRicochetPlayer.name: Ricochet I

SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.
SupportRicochetPlayerTwo.name: Ricochet II

SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.description: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.
flavourText: "Skothe kept us idle, sitting safe on these islands, while our
brethren remain slaves. We are one and the same! We must
fight! So, I bring you his head. I am now your Wolven King!"
SupportRigwaldsFerocityPlayer.name: Rigwald's Ferocity

SupportSalvoPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.
SupportSalvoPlayer.name: Salvo

SupportSecondWindPlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayer.name: Second Wind I

SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayerThree.name: Second Wind III

SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.
SupportSecondWindPlayerTwo.name: Second Wind II

SupportShockPlayer.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.
SupportShockPlayer.name: Shock

SupportShockingLeapPlayer.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.
SupportShockingLeapPlayer.name: Shocking Leap

SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.description: Supports any skill, causing inflicted Slows to be more powerful.
SupportSlowPotencyPlayer.name: Slow Potency

SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.description: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.
SupportSpectralVolleyPlayer.name: Spectral Volley

SupportStormchainPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.
SupportStormchainPlayer.name: Stormchain

SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.
SupportStreamlinedRoundsPlayer.name: Streamlined Rounds

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayer.name: Swift Affliction I

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing effects with a duration of one second or less to deal more non-Ailment damage over time.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerThree.name: Swift Affliction III

SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing it to deal more non-Ailment damage over time but have a shorter duration.
SupportSwiftAfflictionPlayerTwo.name: Swift Affliction II

SupportTacatisIrePlayer.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.
flavourText: He almost saved the Vaal. His unique poison made it past
the Queen's cupbearers; he had only to direct his anger...
but in her presence, he could feel naught but lust.
SupportTacatisIrePlayer.name: Tacati's Ire

SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.description: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.
flavourText: The Chieftain built a grand waikoama, and boasted that
it could never be sunk. Tasalio grinned, and the waves
rolled in, tilting the ship, cresting higher and higher...
SupportTasaliosRhythmPlayer.name: Tasalio's Rhythm

SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.
flavourText: "Countless graves glow silently in endless rows that stretch
on unseen. The living lie within, but do not decay, do not
die. Their eyes remain open, their essence stilled, waiting."
SupportTulsStillnessPlayer.name: Tul's Stillness

SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.
SupportUnerringPowerPlayer.name: Unerring Power

SupportUntouchablePlayer.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.
SupportUntouchablePlayer.name: Untouchable

SupportVoltPlayer.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.
SupportVoltPlayer.name: Volt

SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.
SupportWarmbloodedPlayer.name: Warm Blooded

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayer.name: Window of Opportunity I

SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.description: Supports Channelling skills that have special effects if released with Perfect Timing, causing them to deal much more damage and grant Perfect Deflection if released with Perfect Timing but reducing the Perfect Timing window.
SupportWindowOfOpportunityPlayerTwo.name: Window of Opportunity II

TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.
TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops

TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.description: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which Detonates after a delay, dealing Attack damage. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.
TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.name: Poison Spores

TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.description: Explodes to deal Cold Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.
TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.name: Ice Fragments
